sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Chain Bracelet Combo Set – Sleek Snake Chain & Classic Figaro Link
sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your wrist game with this chic gold-toned duo. Combining a modern flat snake chain with a timeless Figaro link, this high-fashion set is perfect for effortless layering. To maintain its radiant luster, keep these pieces dry and store safely in a dry place after every wear.
